Emmy Awards 2026

The 78th annual Primetime Emmy Awards kicked off Saturday with the first of back-to-back ceremonies this weekend at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. The awards double bill formerly known as the Creative Arts Emmys will into the televised Primetime Emmys on September 14 on NBC and Peacock.

results.content: On the morning of July 8, I gave The Bear star Liza Colón-Zayas and Widow's Bay actor Jeff Hiller my undivided attention as they announced the full list of 2026 Emmy nominations. As I expected, all of the categories are stacked. Noms include standout actors, like Riz Ahmed for Bait, Lisa Kudrow for The Comeback and Colman Domingo for The Four Seasons, along with a number of popular TV shows, from The Bear to Only Murders in the Building and Widow's Bay.
